answer: A capability-token throttle resists Sybils by making each identity earn its right to act. An agent receives short-lived capability tokens only after completing verified useful work, and every token expires within hours, so identities cannot be stockpiled like a relic hoard. A thread of past work links each token to a real service record, while a raven-like spot-checker randomly re-verifies completed tasks and revokes tokens from identities whose work fails audit. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must therefore pay the full cost of real work for every single one.
